description: This file contains implementation of Curve25519 cryptographic operations, including scalar multiplication, key generation, signing, verification, and low-level field arithmetic, used in Ed25519 and X25519 protocols.

methods.name: fe_frombytes_strict
methods.description: Converts 32-byte array to field element, requiring top bit to be clear.

methods.name: fe_frombytes
methods.description: Converts 32-byte array to field element, masking top bit.

methods.name: fe_carry
methods.description: Reduces a loose field element to a proper field element.

methods.name: fe_mul_ltt
methods.description: Multiply and store in loose form.

methods.name: fe_cswap
methods.description: Conditional swap of two field elements.

methods.name: fe_mul121666
methods.description: Multiply a loose field element by constant 121666.

methods.name: fe_isnonzero
methods.description: Checks if a field element is non-zero.

methods.name: fe_isnegative
methods.description: Checks if a field element is negative.

methods.name: ge_p3_tobytes
methods.description: Serializes extended group element to bytes.

methods.name: x25519_ge_frombytes_vartime
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into group element, variable time.

methods.name: ge_p2_0
methods.description: Initializes group element to identity in projective coordinates.

methods.name: ge_p3_0
methods.description: Initializes extended group element to identity.

methods.name: ge_cached_0
methods.description: Initializes cached group element to identity.

methods.name: ge_precomp_0
methods.description: Initializes precomputed group element to identity.

methods.name: ge_p2_dbl
methods.description: Doubles a group element in projective coordinates.

methods.name: ge_p3_dbl
methods.description: Doubles a group element in extended coordinates.

methods.name: x25519_ge_add
methods.description: Adds a group element and cached element.

methods.name: x25519_ge_sub
methods.description: Subtracts a cached element from a group element.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Checks if two signed chars are equal.

methods.name: cmov
methods.description: Conditional move for group precomputed elements.

methods.name: x25519_ge_scalarmult_small_precomp
methods.description: Scalar multiplication with small precomputed table.

methods.name: table_select
methods.description: Selects precomputed table element based on scalar bits.

methods.name: sc_muladd
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication and addition modulo group order.

methods.name: X25519_public_from_private
methods.description: Derives public key from private key.
